interpretation: These intervals end at outgoing manager-to-ArduCopter sensor records. They do not measure receipt of AP sensor data; that protocol direction does not exist.
included_but_unseparated: previous step record serialization and buffered wire write
clock DDS publication and clock-log write
outer-loop health, file checks and bookkeeping
next physical model worker RPC and associated validation
sensor encoding and nonblocking UDP send
limitations: No exclusive attribution to model computation, filesystem I/O, OS descheduling or either FC.
Wire wall fields are original floating-point timestamps; Decimal differences preserve their recorded values, not additional clock precision.
These are PV-specific observations and are distinct from M1 kernel-wire-correlation.json.
